The topology auditor's high mask confidence (0.93) is misleading here—it likely segmented the fused hand-bat mass as a single coherent object, failing to detect the internal boundary error. The perceptual auditor's 'slight blur' verdict misses the AI-specific 'waxy' texture of the background figures.
